issue.title: YSQL, infra: Running unit tests against older existing databases

labels.name: kind/enhancement
labels.description: This is an enhancement of an existing feature

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Currently unit-tests can only be run against the database that are constructed by the same build.
I'd like to be able run the unit tests against an older / existing databases.
Half of my bugs are compatibility issues, so it'd be a great help if we have the above support.

body: Looks like this is caused by column id shift between release and debug builds, I will try a fix for this.
Resolved by having a separate YSQL initdb snapshot for debug/release: https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db-ysql-catalog-snapshots/releases/tag/v2.0.9.0
